evidence_status: 2022 Lövsta generator and annual total heat production documented; 2020 prices observed; thermal service profile and auxiliary/sink economics HYPOTHETICAL
methodological_note: 24-h cross-year simulated CHP and synthetic constant thermal service; no observed hourly heat demand, backup system, heat rejection or export cash flow. Perfect foresight LP, no start/ramp/min load.
observed_plant_reference: Åberg (2024) SLU thesis, Lövsta 2022 annual electricity 3002.6 MWh, heat 2939.5 MWh and 499 kW generator rating
observed_market_reference: Svenska kraftnät historic SE3 day-ahead prices (CC BY 4.0), 2020-01-01 local Sweden
heat_demand_provenance: HYPOTHETICAL constant hourly heat requirement set equal to 2022 annual heat PRODUCTION / 8760h; this is NOT measured heat demand or thermal sales
auxiliary_heat_and_sink_provenance: EUR 80/MWhth backup cost, 0.5 MWth backup/sink capacities are entirely assumed scenario coefficients, not Lövsta plant characteristics
